title: GET /items/{id} with a 404 for unknown ids
task: Add GET /items/{item_id} to the FastAPI service in app/main.py: for a known id respond 200 with the stored item in the same JSON shape POST /items returns; for an unknown id respond 404 with the body {"detail": "item not found"}. Use the existing ItemStore.get from app/store.py. No new dependencies.
